name: Vitrake ex

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
flavorText: Two quiet horns. One unmistakable warning.
system: Physical Pokémon TCG; custom fan card, not tournament legal or Pokémon TCG Pocket.
designNotes: Dragon is the Pokémon type. There is no Basic Dragon Energy; Fire and Water costs echo the two reservoirs. Both attacks use the attacking Pokémon's Dragon type for Weakness and Resistance.
Colorless costs can be paid by any Energy type. Attacking does not normally discard attached Energy; retreating requires discarding Energy to pay the Retreat Cost.
Modern Dragon cards commonly have no Weakness or Resistance. This is a supported card-design convention, not the video-game type chart or a rule for every historical Dragon card.
This is an ordinary Pokémon ex, not a Mega Evolution. It gives up 2 Prize cards when Knocked Out; the full-art/foil treatment is cosmetic.
Acid Spray uses an existing TCG name and exact current-style effect wording. Its one-Colorless cost has precedent at 20 damage; Vitrake's 30 damage is custom tuning.
Dragon Pulse uses Dragonite 151's existing 180-damage and two-card self-discard combination. Fire + Water + Colorless is Vitrake's custom cost, not a verbatim copy of that Dragonite attack.

Vitrake, its HP and combined card values, JWS set identifier, collector number and gift edition are original fan design. They are not an official release or a tournament-legal card. No regulation mark is assigned.
Rules reviewed 2026-09-11 using the July 2026 Pitch Black rulebook and September 1, 2026 TCG Tournament Handbook, reached from the live official Rules & Resources page.
No competitive playtesting claim. Fixed damage and mixed Energy costs are a reasonable gift-card starting point; discarding from the deck can sometimes help a strategy.
flavorText is optional companion copy, not an extra card effect or text printed on this modern ex card face.

Dragon, Fire, Water and Colorless symbols are unchanged official website PNG assets. Their source URLs and checksums are recorded in assets/tcg-symbols/sources.json; this does not make the fan card official.
